Natalya Sokolova

The Black Tusk leader in The Division 2's seasonal story, also named in Hunted's source-specific account of the operation exploiting Maira Kanhai.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision game universe Canon scopegame canon Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Black Tusk leadership in game story

The Division 2's official seasonal story places Sokolova in an overt leadership role as Black Tusk's Washington campaign becomes more aggressive. [1]

Operation: Crossroads connection — major spoilers

Hunted attaches Sokolova to a distinct Black Tusk operation involving Maira Kanhai. That novel connection is recorded as a source-specific bridge; it is not used to invent missing operational details for the game's wider chronology. [2]
